rca of the issue: Previous iteration_3 blocker: /api/uploads/image was role-gated to OWNER/ADMIN/STAF via require_roles. The pelanggan UI (PesananDetailPage.jsx line ~35) called this exact endpoint when uploading bukti bayar, triggering 403 'Hak akses tidak mencukupi'. Fix: routes_uploads.py line 17 now reads require_roles(ROLE_OWNER, ROLE_ADMIN, ROLE_STAF, ROLE_PELANGGAN) only for the /image route (video unchanged). Verified: pelanggan upload returns 200 with proper payload; subsequent POST /api/orders/{id}/bukti-bayar attaches URL and advances status to MENUNGGU_VERIFIKASI as expected.
